seats.findings:
🟠 [bulk-threshold-off-by-one] MUST-FIX src/bulk.js:5 uses `qty > 10`, so a quantity of exactly 10 gets no discount although the contract says the discount applies when qty is 10 or more; change the comparison to `qty >= 10`
🟠 [coupon-divisor-wrong] MUST-FIX src/coupon.js:5 divides by 1000 instead of 100, so every coupon discount is one tenth of the contracted Math.round(subtotal * pct / 100), and src/checkout.js:7 inherits the wrong total through couponCents; change the divisor to 100

🔴 [coupon-div-1000] MUST-FIX src/coupon.js:5 couponCents computes Math.round((subtotal * p) / 1000) but the contract requires Math.round(subtotal * pct / 100), so every coupon discount is 10x too small (e.g. pct=10, subtotal=2000 returns 20 instead of 200) and src/checkout.js:7 inherits the error through couponCents, undercharging/mis-totalling every checkout with a coupon; change the divisor to 100.
🟠 [bulk-gte-10] MUST-FIX src/bulk.js:5 the condition `qty > 10` applies the 10% bulk discount only from qty 11, but the contract grants it "when qty is 10 or more", so a 10-unit line is overcharged (e.g. 10 × 100 returns 1000 instead of 900); change the test to `qty >= 10`.
🔵 [chunk-n-guard] CUT/FOLLOW-UP src/chunk.js:5 chunkArray loops without terminating if n <= 0, but the contract never defines n=0 and no caller passes it; adding a guard is optional hardening excluded from this version.

🟠 [bulk-threshold] MUST-FIX src/bulk.js:4 uses `qty > 10` but the spec says "when qty is 10 or more"; qty=10 incorrectly gets no discount. Change to `qty >= 10`.
🟠 [coupon-divisor] MUST-FIX src/coupon.js:4 divides by 1000 instead of 100, producing a discount one-tenth of the specified value. Change `/ 1000` to `/ 100`. This also corrupts checkoutTotal which delegates to couponCents.
🟠 [invoice-format] MUST-FIX src/invoice.js:5 returns the numeric sum `amount + tax` but the spec says the format is "label: amount+tax" (both values shown, e.g. "Widget: 1000+200"). Change to `` `${label}: ${amount}+${taxCents(amount, rateBp)}` ``.
